prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1219; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Great. Please describe where the accident happened.

A: It was on a multi-lane road in League City, Texas, heading toward the freeway. I was in the right lane and wanted to move over to the left lane because I needed to make a turn coming up.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked clear, put on my signal, and started moving over. Then I felt a bump on the side of my car and heard a loud scrape.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: Not really. I think it was in my blind spot. I didn't see it until after the contact.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: I'd guess around thirty-five or forty miles an hour. Traffic was moving steadily.

Q: After the impact, what happened next?

A: I pulled onto the shoulder and got out to look at the damage. The other driver was already out of his car. We exchanged information and called the police.

Q: Did you receive medical attention?

A: Yes. I felt stiffness in my neck right away, and by the next morning I had pain running into my shoulders and headaches. I went to urgent care and they diagnosed me with whiplash. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?

A: Yes, I still get stiffness when I turn my head quickly, and I can't sit for long periods without discomfort.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: I've missed a few days, and I've had to adjust my schedule for appointments.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
